n100_deletion_bound.lower_bound_definition: lb = max(type1_forced_lb, maximal_matching_lb) on blocker-edge vertex-cover instance; sound VC lower bounds per agent_a/scripts/blocker_audit.py

r1_exclusion_logic.claim: For Hamming r=1 shell |R|=1,|A|=2 aiming at size 165: each new q in A must be legal vs S0\\R. A sound LB>=2 for every q vs full S0 implies that deleting a single baseline point cannot clear all Type1/Type2 certificates for any q. Adding a second new point cannot remove certificates involving remaining baseline points. Therefore no legal S with |S|=165 exists inside the GLOBAL r=1 Hamming shell around S0.
r1_exclusion_logic.forbidden_wording: Do NOT write C(100)<=164 from this argument alone without dual-certified search; this is a structural exclusion of the r=1 shell model only.

u_small_48_definition.selection_rule: Remove: top removal_score (crowding+boundary+blocking; n100 already fully 180-symmetric). Add: lowest delta_V among DeltaV<=5 (empirical min DeltaV=3; 16 cells at <=3), mostly frame/mid, 2 center probes.
u_small_48_definition.deterministic: Explicit coordinate lists stored in Agent C JSON; reproducible without re-scoring if lists are used as canonical.
u_small_48_definition.giant_cc_note: Agent A blocker-projection CC is one giant component (all 164 points). U_small is score/delta_V top-M from Agent C, NOT a connected-component cut of that giant graph.
u_small_48_definition.misses: Any +1 whose Rem outside rem pool or Add outside add pool; deep-center mass; blocker-halo neighbors not in score/spatial selection.

n100_primary_breakthrough.add_source: union(Agent A all 16 qs with exact min deletions 2, Agent C U_small.addable_unselected_points)
n100_primary_breakthrough.halo_enlarge: Grow rem via C U_large; union remaining low-LB qs from A; spatial+blocker halo; then U_medium_r2 / U_large_r2
n100_primary_breakthrough.scoped_unsat_claim: INFEASIBLE under scope=(n=100,r=2,U_small_r2,...) only — not a global C(100)<=164
